**Direction read**

The structure is down, and BTC is sitting just above its first key support [1]. The immediate decision zone is: hold 62211.53333333, or fail and head toward 61030.92 [1]. To turn constructive, price needs to reclaim 62921.235, which would open a path toward 63987.215 [1]. Above that, 65655.81 is the next major resistance [1].

The news backdrop reinforces caution: BTC hit a three-week low [12], slid on July 31 [18], mining difficulty fell 14% from its yearly high [11], and negative security headlines are circulating [13][14][15][16]. There is no reported reversal trigger [implied from that coverage]. Social sentiment is split, but the loud bullish posts are promotional rather than analytical [24][28], while macro commentary is more cautious/bearish [23][27].

So my read: bearish unless BTC reclaims 62921.235; the key risk is losing 62211.53333333, which would likely send price toward 61030.92 [1]. Your open SELL at 63098.39 is not the reason for this view, but it is on the same side as the current technical bias.
